Pass the cart test file straight to Node's test runner:

```sh
node --test tests/cart.test.ts
```

I ran it and both cart tests passed.

Don't use `npm test -- tests/cart.test.ts` for this. The `test` script already includes `"tests/*.test.ts"`, so npm would add your file to that pattern and still run every test file, including `money.test.ts`.

To run a single test inside the file by name, add `--test-name-pattern`:

```sh
node --test --test-name-pattern="discount" tests/cart.test.ts
```
